scope: Quality gates and desktop host behaviour were re-run on a second machine with a different OS build and GPU. Model installation, real generation, resource budget and network-denied runs stay on the target machine; this record does not extend the supported model hardware.

environments.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 3080 Ti 12288 MiB, compute capability 8.6
NVIDIA GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER 8192 MiB, compute capability 7.5, driver 560.94

rust_tests.note: The four additional tests belong to the new startup diagnostics module; no previously passing test regressed.

cases.expected: native window, creation page, tasks/works empty states, model page and settings render on the release build
theme change persists across a restart
two instances with different --data-dir roots coexist, each with its own WebView2 profile
release build writes logs/startup-failure.log, shows the Chinese dialog and exits 3 instead of 101

not_verified_on_supplementary: real Z-Image generation and image quality
CUDA reserved / private commit / RAM budget
host and supervisor kill recovery during sampling

model_scope.reason: The frozen recipe measured a 8.87 GiB CUDA reserved peak (budget 10.5 GiB) and uses BF16 compute on sm86. An 8 GiB Turing card cannot hold that peak and does not provide the recipe BF16 path, so it is outside the registered support scope. Shrinking resolution, steps or quantization to fit is not allowed by the change.
